key_decisions.decision: Keeps the teacher's first-person instruction and direct audience.
Preserves mashal and riddles as the framing of history.
Preserves both heart and spirit diagnoses without importing ethnic generalizations.
Keeps the named tribe and reversal without inventing a battle identification.
Keeps mighty ones rather than specifying angels without a note.
Keeps the source's singular possessive rather than silently harmonizing to their.
Preserves lethal action and the specific younger males.
Retains atonement, restraint and repeated mercy without erasing judgment.
Keeps flesh and wind as human fragility images.
Chooses pained for the difficult verb, preserving the specific divine title.
Keeps frost as a qualified reading of the rare destructive-weather term.
Retains the wrath list and harmful messengers without making them morally evil spirits.
Preserves firstborn, reproductive strength and ancestral designation Ham.
Keeps dispossession, allocation and occupied dwellings explicit.
Retains cultic high places and jealousy rather than reducing both to generic wrongdoing.
Retains the metaphorical strength/splendor language; notes the ark association.
Retains gender-specific losses and the suppressed marriage celebration.
Keeps absent mourning without inventing a reason.
Preserves the striking wine and awakening simile without sanitizing it.
Retains the ambiguous rearward blow and lasting disgrace.
Retains heights rather than specifying mountains absent from this noun.
Preserves nursing sheep and the transfer to human shepherding.
